title: Module 3 Boss Challenge: SaaS Support Agent Memory Architect
scenario: Your customer support AI agent is experiencing 4 critical failures in production. You must diagnose the missing architectural component and assign the exact memory tier required to fix each bug.

diagnoses.symptom: The agent repeatedly asks the user for their account ID and order number even after the user provided it two messages ago.
diagnoses.requiredFix: Short-term Memory buffer / In-session context window
diagnoses.explanation: Short-term memory tracks previous turns in the ongoing conversation.

diagnoses.symptom: When a customer says 'I'm still having the issue I reported yesterday', the agent has no record of the ticket.
diagnoses.explanation: Long-term persistent storage carries context across distinct sessions.

diagnoses.symptom: The agent hallucinates return policies or provides generic answers even though detailed company return FAQs exist.
diagnoses.requiredFix: External Knowledge Memory (Vector Database via RAG)
diagnoses.explanation: External memory with semantic retrieval grounds answers in official documentation.

diagnoses.symptom: When a customer repeatedly expresses intense frustration, the agent remains cheerful and fails to trigger human handoff.
diagnoses.requiredFix: Sentiment tracking in context + Escalation instructions
diagnoses.explanation: Maintaining emotional sentiment state across turns allows the reasoning core to trigger escalation.
